name: Cezanne HR Learning
description:
Cezanne HR Learning is a people development platform that brings learning, skills and performance together in one place. This connector gives Claude authenticated access to your organisation's Cezanne HR Learning workspace through the Cezanne HR Learning V1 API.

Read across your workspace:
- People and teams: users, custom fields, team membership, roles
- Content: items, learnlists, channels and the relationships between them
- Progress and engagement: enrollments, activities, channel progress by person or by channel
- Events, tasks and surveys, including survey responses

Make changes where your permissions allow:
- Create and update users, deactivate and reactivate them
- Create, update and delete teams, and manage their membership
- Create, update and delete content items
- Create enrollments to assign learning
- Delete tasks

Typical questions and requests:
- "Which people in the Sales team have not finished the compliance channel?"
- "Add the six new starters to the Onboarding team and enrol them in Induction."
- "Summarise the responses to our latest engagement survey."
- "Create a learning item for this article and add it to the Leadership channel."

Access and permissions: you sign in with your own Cezanne HR Learning credentials over OAuth. The connector acts as you and inherits your permissions, so it reaches only the data and actions your account already allows. Every tool is annotated as read-only or as modifying data, so Claude's permission prompts distinguish a lookup from a change or a deletion.

Before connecting you will need a Cezanne HR Learning account with connector access enabled by Cezanne HR, and your workspace address, for example acme in acme.learnamp.com.

Cezanne HR Learning is the first party for this API. The connector reaches your own Cezanne HR Learning tenant and no third-party service sits in the path.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Cezanne HR Learning to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Cezanne HR Learning to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api-mcp.learnamp.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Cezanne HR Learning MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cezanne HR Learning lists 58 MCP tools, including deleteV1ItemsId, deleteV1TasksId, deleteV1TeamsByExternalIdExternalId, deleteV1TeamsByExternalIdExternalIdUsersUserId, deleteV1TeamsId, deleteV1TeamsTeamIdUsersUserId, deleteV1UsersId, getV1Activities, getV1AuthLearningspacesSubdomain, getV1Channels, getV1ChannelsChannelIdUsersProgress, and getV1CommunitiesTeamIdPosts.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Cezanne HR Learning?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Cezanne HR Learning in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Cezanne HR Learning MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cezanne HR Learning requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Cezanne HR Learning is developed by Cezanne HR. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
